summary: Eps 1-27 adapt manga chapters 1-38 (mainline MU/fandom numbering, matches our volume boundaries) with heavy resequencing: S1 (1-13) covers the Ikaros arc (chs 1-12) plus the Nymph-arc capture climax (chs 13-15) moved from spring to a Christmas finale, while pulling the culture-festival chapter 21 (vol 5) into ep 10; Forte (15-26) covers the Dive Game (ch 18) and the Astraea-to-Chaos arcs (chs 22-31, 33), with chs 25/26 swapped and an anime-original Chaos-return finale that the manga later did differently as the Chaos Return arc (46-53); the OVA (ep 14) adapts ch 27; Movie 1 (ep 27) adapts the Hiyori arc chs 34-38 faithfully then diverges (Hiyori dies as Angeloid Zeta; in manga chs 39-45 she survives). No per-episode chapter fields exist on the wiki, so most identifications are triangulated from episode summaries, chapter titles/arc fields/debut chapters, and 2009-10 MAL manga-reader threads; five episodes (6, 17, 18, 23, 24) are left unanchored with hypotheses flagged rather than guessed. Bonus: open flag #697 resolves cleanly - AniList's 97 chapters = 77 mainline + 20 Extra chapters listed in the wiki volume lists; anchors use the 77-chapter mainline space.
